conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hi! I just opened my savings account, and I’m so excited! How do I set up NEFT transfers?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s great to hear, ma’am! To set up NEFT, go to the app’s transfer section and add a beneficiary.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Oh, that sounds easy. Do I need anything special for it?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Just the beneficiary’s account number and IFSC code. It takes 24 hours to activate.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Awesome, thanks! You made that super clear.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: You’re welcome! Let me know if you need help with anything else.
